The lone holdout juror who caused Lindsay Clancy’s mistrial asked supporters to turn their focus away from him and instead toward the “three angels” the Massachusetts mom strangled.

“I know the whole focus has been on me, but we want to reel everything back and put the focus on the three angels,” juror Michael P. Desronvil said in an exclusive clip aired on Fox News’s “Hannity” show.

“The ones that can’t speak for themselves. The ones that can’t defend themselves, and the ones that can’t fight their battles. And those are Cora, Dawson, and Callan,” Desronvil said.

Desronvil, a devout Catholic and Haitian immigrant, was thrown into the limelight after he was revealed to be the juror who caused Clancy’s triple-murder case to end in a hung jury.
